name: Lovers of the Galaxy
source:
Meet Peter Squirt who wants to...

Well, he really wants to find his father. For this he is ready to become the best lover in the galaxy, find true friends with the same interests, a real guru and possibly the love of his life!

Lots of humor and juicy scenes await you in the incredible adventures of Peter Squirt.
